title: DAY 5 — LESSON 2: UNDERSTANDING THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN DISAGREEMENT AND DISRESPECT

questions.prompt: What is the main difference between disagreement and disrespect?
options: Disagreement involves different opinions, while disrespect involves inappropriate treatment
Disagreement is always wrong, while disrespect is sometimes necessary
I understand your point, but I see the situation differently.

questions.prompt: An employee respectfully questions a scheduling instruction because it conflicts with another booking. Is this automatically disrespectful?
options: Yes, employees should never ask questions.
Yes, because disagreement always challenges authority.
No, raising a genuine operational concern respectfully can be appropriate.

questions.prompt: What should you do when someone disagrees with your suggestion?
options: Listen, consider their reasoning and respond respectfully

questions.prompt: What does the AGREE method encourage?
options: Arguing until everyone accepts your opinion
Acknowledging perspectives, giving your view, reviewing facts, exploring solutions and establishing next steps
